I added `GET /api/me/export` in `src/app/api/me/export/route.ts`, with narrow explicit-column queries in `src/repos/exportRecord.ts` and tests in `tests/export.test.ts`. `npm run verify` passes.

- **Access and scope:** Only patients can call it, and they only get their own record. Other roles get 403 and unauthenticated callers get 401. The endpoint has no input, so there is no URL or query-string data. It writes an `audit` entry (`record.export`) with ids only, and it logs and caches nothing.
- **Notes:** It reads `clinical_notes` only, never `psychotherapy_notes`. Appointment staff `notes` are left out.
- **Messages:** I included only messages the patient's own user sent or received, not staff-to-staff messages that merely carry the patient's id. That was my call on the most restrictive reading of "sent or received".
